description: This source file contains tests for helper functions related to 'exec approval reply' in a software project. It uses the Vitest testing framework and tests various payload builders, parsers, and related utilities for managing approval workflows and interactive reply messages.

methods.name: getExecApprovalApproverDmNoticeText
methods.description: Returns a static message indicating that approval DM notices have been sent.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalUnavailableReplyPayload
methods.description: Builds a reply payload indicating that exec approval is unavailable, including reason-specific messaging.

methods.name: getExecApprovalReplyMetadata
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes metadata from reply payloads related to exec approval, filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalPendingReplyPayload
methods.description: Constructs a reply payload for pending approval status, including interactive buttons and formatted information.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalActionDescriptors
methods.description: Generates descriptors for approval decision actions (allow once, allow always, deny).

methods.name: buildExecApprovalInteractiveReply
methods.description: Creates an interactive reply message with action buttons based on approval command ID.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalCommandText
methods.description: Forms a command string for approving with specified decision.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalCommandText
methods.description: Parses a command string to extract approval ID and decision, if valid.
